en-US.shortDescription: Risk-gates purchases Alexa+ attempts on your behalf before they complete
en-US.fullDescription: Alguard evaluates every purchase, booking, or subscription Alexa+ attempts on your behalf. Everyday, low-risk purchases complete automatically. Purchases in higher-risk categories (gift cards, wire transfers, gambling, crypto) or that look unusual for your account are paused and require your explicit approval in the Alexa app before they complete — Alexa+ itself never approves its own halted purchase.
examplePhrases: Buy a $50 gift card from that site
Subscribe to this service for me
Check the status of my last purchase attempt

carouselImages.altText: Alguard halting a risky purchase for approval
